goal: Rebuild the existing 13-slide CHOOGuard proposal into genuinely different, professionally composed graphics. The user rejected the previous white/blue rectangular-card treatment, monotonous headers/footers, palette, layout, and claimed tool use. User criticism is ground truth; do not repeat checks to confirm it.
immutableMeaning: Train a station employee to apply learned response principles in changing conditions
Learn basic controls and response; apply in the field; review action records
JEV judges imminent possible atomic transitions derived from current specific people/objects; code samples over time and rechecks conditions
Do not introduce a fixed incident catalog or fixed incident kinds/locations/times/counts
NPCs use their own observations and received announcements, not omniscient world information or private station-employee radio
Manuals and verified materials determine correct response; AI does not replace them
Current desktop development evidence must remain distinct from planned VR/target UI
No fabricated education gains, cost savings, response-time statistics, grades, dates, team members or measurements
Keep all six required topics; eight-week calendar is a proposal, not supplied course dates

direction.name: Station Field Atlas
direction.character: railway wayfinding meets technical editorial atlas; precise, human, field-oriented; not SaaS dashboard cards or generic consultancy deck
direction.paletteFamily: Graphite/deep midnight, warm ivory/mist, electric lime emphasis. One vivid accent plus tonal neutrals. Actual photo colors are retained.
direction.colorComposition: Large deliberate ground-color fields, alternation of paper/night/accent pages, figure-ground separation, photo-derived neutral anchors; not merely changing a few font colors
direction.meaningOfAccent: attention, focal relationships, current chapter; never a fake success/pass status
direction.typography: Korean thesis headlines, English/numeric editorial folios, contrasting display vs body weights, deliberate line grouping and tracking. Body generally 30–34px; concise graphic labels >=28px; source captions >=24px. Huge lettering must carry actual information, not compensate for weak composition.
direction.header: chapter number + bilingual section identifier + product wordmark; alternate ink/paper treatments appropriate to page ground, not the same two tiny corner strings
direction.footer: compact route-style progress across the six actual proposal topics, active chapter label, deliberate folio; no uniform tiny XR-Lab/page-number-only footer
direction.decorations: No meaningless blobs, random icons, stock business imagery, fake charts, decorative color stripes, heavy drop shadows or busy gradients. Route lines/track motifs must encode actual sequence, dependencies or reader position.

pagePlans.graphic: transparent station concept on a large accent/neutral field; strong mixed-language project identity and quiet concept disclosure
memorization-to-application contrast, strong editorial Korean words, reality constraint versus observation/judgment/action; no three equal square cards

pagePlans.layout: wayfinding journey across three learning phases
pagePlans.graphic: learn→contextual response→reflect route with four actual response-stage stops nested inside Apply; use native pictograms rather than repeated rectangles
four requirement clusters grouped around one station-employee training core; concise implementation and completion criteria; manual-grounding rail
Unity/Input/JEV current foundation and clearly marked planned XR layer; native layered/exploded structure, not a logo list or equal columns
current state→atomic candidates→JEV→time sampling/recheck→updated state loop; strong AI/code responsibility differentiation; native editable diagram
observed danger, received announcements and position feed individual knowledge then behavior; scope of information visualized, not all-global truth boxes
dominant actual first-person view, locator/caption system, inset station and train details; full-size photos, not the old white four-image montage
current image as context plus native planned spatial-selection UI and action-record slate; prominent TARGET status; all overlay text remains editable
W1–W4 linked milestones with work/output/check; avoid copying the earlier four-row table
W5–W8 progression with basic guidance, integration, beta observations, final package; iteration relation from beta to improvement
learning/use/operations headings visually differentiated and tied to the observations that will validate them; no unmeasured numerical KPI chart
linked reference entries with short readable display URLs/labels, project/media attribution, considered closing typography; no authoring-process commentary

infographicContract.renderer: installed AntV Infographic workflow; render actual local SVGs rather than only naming a skill
infographicContract.editableText: Export shape-only SVG plus exact text-layout records (x,y,width,height,text,size,weight,color,alignment). Parent imports editable vectors and recreates labels as native Figma TEXT. Do not flatten whole-slide images.
infographicContract.style: large structural geometry and native/vector pictograms, not equal gray rectangles linked by tiny arrows
infographicContract.evidence: Record exact template name, render invocation, generated asset paths and observed render result. No claims of tool use without execution.

acceptance: Same intended body, all six topics, radically different graphic composition
No consecutive runs of identical card/table page layouts
Headers and footers carry useful reader orientation
Palette is visible in background/foreground massing and rhythm, not just tiny accents
Typography is a deliberate system and visibly composed
Real infographic render results used in native Figma composition
All 13 actual Figma renders inspected with independent composition/type/color critique
Show before/after comparison of representative pages and name exact tools actually used
executionLimits: Only new proposal artifact files in named output paths; no changes to user originals or Unity code
No credential/configuration changes, installs or unrelated scans
No remote Figma mutations by slices; parent integrates
Skip tests/build/lint/formatters mid-flight; parent runs the final relevant artifact smoke and visual QA
If a named plugin command is unavailable, report exact failure and apply/read the actual installed command workflow without falsely claiming command execution
